Find more like this: a board card's or a tagged chart's button
note: Measured on a member with a chart plan of their own: the run makes the note through the member's route and runs the overnight find-similar job for it (tools/notebook_fin_walk.py run_post_child), so the card carries the button and stored matches exist. An example card never carries it. If the seed did not land the row is NOT_MEASURED; if it landed and the button is absent the row is HIDDEN.

feature: Note resurfacing: the Notices box on Research Home
note: The box renders only while the member has a notice, and a fresh sandbox member has none (a resurfaced note needs the overnight awareness scan). A resurfaced note reaches the box through GET /api/voice/insights (403 without voice access), so that is the feed this row answers, through page.route, with one note_level_touch insight whose link opens one of the member's notes. The box, its position and its label are the real product code, the data is not. With no notice the box is absent by design (components/notebook/NoticesBox.jsx returns null).
